text:
anya: quick idea 1: add a precision-contract lint in CI to validate profile files before packaging?
matt: yes please. Two layers: cheap static lint + runtime admission during deploy.
priya: static lint covers schema and obvious anti-patterns (fallback loops, missing quality_anchor). runtime checks for hw/kernel compatibility.
jordan: static rules I'd enforce: no fp8 without explicit fallbacks, quality_anchor present, hw_compat if fp8.
anya: agree. If fp8 is declared require hw_compat to avoid assuming parity across GPUs.
matt: propose a tiny DSL so linter can reason across fields. Example:
```yaml
profile:
  model: mixtral-8x
  allowed_precisions: [fp8, int8, int4]
  quality_anchor: evals/cli-compat-v1
  fallbacks: [int8, int4]
  hw_compat: [h100,a100]
  requires_canary: true
```
priya: lint rules: allowed_precisions subset of manifest, fallbacks non-empty if fp8, no cycles, quality_anchor non-empty or requires_canary true.
jordan: also a rule to flag mixing fp8 + headwise-int4 unless explicitly tested. Headwise regressions bite.
matt: surface failures as GH action annotations. Add a lint --fix that normalizes files and inserts TODOs for manual review.
anya: migration: codemod to convert legacy profiles to DSL, mark missing fields as requires_canary.
priya: runtime admission sketch: deploy agent POSTs profile to runtime /admit, runtime returns a small structured verdict as text e.g. "allowed=true; warnings=[kv-cache=false may break fp8]; recommended_variant=int8-safe".
jordan: runtime should do light compatibility checks only (kernels, kv-cache flags, quant version). Heavy evals belong to staging.
matt: integrate: precision-lint GH action -> if passes, deploy calls runtime/admit; if runtime returns allowed=false block rollout and notify ops. Ops can override with audit log.
ci-bot: precision-lint v0.2 published; default rules + experimental headwise ban.
anya: action items: matt+priya draft DSL + lint rules PR, jordan specs runtime/admit schema, anya wires GH action and codemod scaffold. I'll open a draft branch.
priya: I'll add a sample profile to docs and ping @matt.
matt: I'll add README note about fp8 hardware variance and headwise caveats.
ci-bot: opened issue #1302: precision-ci-admission (assignee: anya)
